disagreements.sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('DAY', alerts.resolved_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei') AS period_start, COUNT(DISTINCT alerts.severity) AS m0, CAST((COUNT(DISTINCT sites.site_name)) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT sites.site_name)) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('DAY', alerts.resolved_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')), 0) AS m1, CAST((COUNT(DISTINCT alerts.severity) - LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT alerts.severity)) OVER (ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('DAY', alerts.resolved_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei'))) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT alerts.severity)) OVER (ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('DAY', alerts.resolved_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')), 0) AS m0_growth FROM public.alerts LEFT JOIN public.devices ON alerts.device_id = devices.device_id LEFT JOIN public.sites ON devices.site_id = sites.site_id WHERE sites.tz IN (%(f_0)s) GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('DAY', alerts.resolved_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei') ORDER BY m0 NULLS FIRST LIMIT %(limit_1)s

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('DAY', alerts.resolved_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei') AS period_start, devices.model AS model, alerts.severity AS severity, SUM(alerts.downtime_minutes) FILTER(WHERE alerts.severity IN (%(f_0)s)) AS m0 FROM public.alerts LEFT JOIN public.devices ON alerts.device_id = devices.device_id GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('DAY', alerts.resolved_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei'), devices.model, alerts.severity ORDER BY period_start NULLS FIRST, model NULLS FIRST, severity NULLS FIRST

errors.sql: SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('DAY', devices.installed_on) AS DATE) AS period_start, sites.site_name AS site_name, devices.firmware AS firmware, CAST((MIN(devices.monthly_fee) FILTER(WHERE sites.region IS NULL)) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(SUM(MIN(devices.monthly_fee) FILTER(WHERE sites.region IS NULL)) OVER (PARTITION BY CAST(DATE_TRUNC('DAY', devices.installed_on) AS DATE)), 0) AS m0, AVG(devices.monthly_fee) AS m1, CAST((CAST((MIN(devices.monthly_fee) FILTER(WHERE sites.region IS NULL)) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(SUM(MIN(devices.monthly_fee) FILTER(WHERE sites.region IS NULL)) OVER (PARTITION BY CAST(DATE_TRUNC('DAY', devices.installed_on) AS DATE)), 0) - LAG(CAST((MIN(devices.monthly_fee) FILTER(WHERE sites.region IS NULL)) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(SUM(MIN(devices.monthly_fee) FILTER(WHERE sites.region IS NULL)) OVER (PARTITION BY CAST(DATE_TRUNC('DAY', devices.installed_on) AS DATE)), 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY sites.site_name, devices.firmware ORDER BY CAST(DATE_TRUNC('DAY', devices.installed_on) AS DATE))) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(LAG(CAST((MIN(devices.monthly_fee) FILTER(WHERE sites.region IS NULL)) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(SUM(MIN(devices.monthly_fee) FILTER(WHERE sites.region IS NULL)) OVER (PARTITION BY CAST(DATE_TRUNC('DAY', devices.installed_on) AS DATE)), 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY sites.site_name, devices.firmware ORDER BY CAST(DATE_TRUNC('DAY', devices.installed_on) AS DATE)), 0) AS m0_growth FROM public.devices LEFT JOIN public.sites ON devices.site_id = sites.site_id WHERE devices.monthly_fee <= %(f_0)s AND (devices.installed_on >= %(p1_start_1)s AND devices.installed_on < %(p1_end_2)s) GROUP BY CAST(DATE_TRUNC('DAY', devices.installed_on) AS DATE), sites.site_name, devices.firmware HAVING AVG(devices.monthly_fee) >= %(h_3)s ORDER BY site_name DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT devices.status AS status, sites.tz AS tz, AVG(devices.monthly_fee) AS m0, CAST((CAST((MAX(devices.installed_on) FILTER(WHERE devices.firmware IN (%(f_0)s))) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT sites.site_name), 0)) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST((MAX(devices.installed_on) FILTER(WHERE devices.firmware IN (%(f_0)s))) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT sites.site_name), 0)) OVER (), 0) AS m1 FROM public.devices LEFT JOIN public.sites ON devices.site_id = sites.site_id WHERE sites.region = %(f_1)s AND (devices.installed_on >= DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', (SELECT MAX(devices.installed_on) FROM public.devices LEFT JOIN public.sites ON devices.site_id = sites.site_id WHERE sites.region = %(f_1)s)) AND devices.installed_on < (DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', (SELECT MAX(devices.installed_on) FROM public.devices LEFT JOIN public.sites ON devices.site_id = sites.site_id WHERE sites.region = %(f_1)s)) + INTERVAL '1 month')) GROUP BY devices.status, sites.tz ORDER BY status NULLS FIRST, tz NULLS FIRST

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', readings.measured_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei') AS period_start, devices.firmware AS firmware, sites.site_name AS site_name, CAST((SUM(devices.monthly_fee)) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(SUM(SUM(devices.monthly_fee)) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', readings.measured_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')), 0) AS m0, CAST((MIN(readings.throughput_mbps)) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS m1, CAST((CAST((SUM(devices.monthly_fee)) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(SUM(SUM(devices.monthly_fee)) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', readings.measured_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')), 0) - LAG(CAST((SUM(devices.monthly_fee)) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(SUM(SUM(devices.monthly_fee)) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', readings.measured_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')), 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY devices.firmware, sites.site_name ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', readings.measured_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei'))) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(LAG(CAST((SUM(devices.monthly_fee)) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(SUM(SUM(devices.monthly_fee)) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', readings.measured_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')), 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY devices.firmware, sites.site_name ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', readings.measured_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')), 0) AS m0_growth FROM public.readings LEFT JOIN public.devices ON readings.device_id = devices.device_id LEFT JOIN public.sites ON devices.site_id = sites.site_id WHERE readings.measured_at >= %(p1_start_0)s AND readings.measured_at < %(p1_end_1)s GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', readings.measured_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei'), devices.firmware, sites.site_name ORDER BY period_start NULLS FIRST, firmware NULLS FIRST, site_name NULLS FIRST

SELECT sites.site_name AS site_name, devices.firmware AS firmware, CAST((MAX(alerts.raised_at)) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE sites.tz IN (%(f_0)s)), 0) AS m0 FROM public.alerts LEFT JOIN public.devices ON alerts.device_id = devices.device_id LEFT JOIN public.sites ON devices.site_id = sites.site_id WHERE alerts.downtime_minutes < %(f_1)s AND (alerts.raised_at >= %(p1_start_2)s AND alerts.raised_at < %(p1_end_3)s) GROUP BY sites.site_name, devices.firmware ORDER BY site_name NULLS FIRST, firmware NULLS FIRST

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('DAY', alerts.resolved_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei') AS period_start, MAX(alerts.resolved_at) AS m0, CAST((COUNT(DISTINCT sites.site_name)) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT sites.site_name)) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('DAY', alerts.resolved_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')), 0) AS m1, CAST((MAX(alerts.resolved_at) - LAG(MAX(alerts.resolved_at)) OVER (ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('DAY', alerts.resolved_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei'))) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(LAG(MAX(alerts.resolved_at)) OVER (ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('DAY', alerts.resolved_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')), 0) AS m0_growth FROM public.alerts LEFT JOIN public.devices ON alerts.device_id = devices.device_id LEFT JOIN public.sites ON devices.site_id = sites.site_id WHERE sites.tz IN (%(f_0)s) GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('DAY', alerts.resolved_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei') ORDER BY m0 NULLS FIRST LIMIT %(limit_1)s

SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', devices.installed_on) AS DATE) AS period_start, sites.region AS region, devices.status AS status, CAST((CAST((COUNT(DISTINCT sites.site_id)) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT devices.status), 0)) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST((COUNT(DISTINCT sites.site_id)) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT devices.status), 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY CAST(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', devices.installed_on) AS DATE)), 0) AS m0, CAST((SUM(devices.monthly_fee)) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT sites.tz), 0) AS m1, CAST((CAST((CAST((COUNT(DISTINCT sites.site_id)) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT devices.status), 0)) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST((COUNT(DISTINCT sites.site_id)) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT devices.status), 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY CAST(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', devices.installed_on) AS DATE)), 0) - LAG(CAST((CAST((COUNT(DISTINCT sites.site_id)) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT devices.status), 0)) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST((COUNT(DISTINCT sites.site_id)) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT devices.status), 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY CAST(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', devices.installed_on) AS DATE)), 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY sites.region, devices.status ORDER BY CAST(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', devices.installed_on) AS DATE))) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(LAG(CAST((CAST((COUNT(DISTINCT sites.site_id)) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT devices.status), 0)) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST((COUNT(DISTINCT sites.site_id)) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT devices.status), 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY CAST(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', devices.installed_on) AS DATE)), 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY sites.region, devices.status ORDER BY CAST(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', devices.installed_on) AS DATE)), 0) AS m0_growth FROM public.devices LEFT JOIN public.sites ON devices.site_id = sites.site_id WHERE devices.firmware = %(f_0)s GROUP BY CAST(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', devices.installed_on) AS DATE), sites.region, devices.status ORDER BY period_start NULLS FIRST, region NULLS FIRST, status NULLS FIRST

SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', devices.installed_on) AS DATE) AS period_start, MAX(devices.installed_on) AS m0, CAST((MAX(devices.installed_on) - LAG(MAX(devices.installed_on)) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', devices.installed_on) AS DATE))) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(LAG(MAX(devices.installed_on)) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', devices.installed_on) AS DATE)), 0) AS m0_growth FROM public.devices LEFT JOIN public.sites ON devices.site_id = sites.site_id WHERE sites.tz = %(f_0)s AND devices.model = %(f_1)s AND ((devices.installed_on >= %(p1_start_2)s AND devices.installed_on < %(p1_end_3)s) OR (devices.installed_on >= %(p2_start_4)s AND devices.installed_on < %(p2_end_5)s)) GROUP BY CAST(DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', devices.installed_on) AS DATE) ORDER BY period_start DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', devices.installed_on) AS DATE) AS period_start, MAX(devices.installed_on) AS m0 FROM public.devices LEFT JOIN public.sites ON devices.site_id = sites.site_id WHERE devices.model = %(f_0)s AND sites.site_name = %(f_1)s AND ((devices.installed_on >= %(p1_start_2)s AND devices.installed_on < %(p1_end_3)s) OR (devices.installed_on >= %(p2_start_4)s AND devices.installed_on < %(p2_end_5)s)) GROUP BY CAST(DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', devices.installed_on) AS DATE) HAVING MAX(devices.installed_on) >= %(h_6)s ORDER BY period_start NULLS FIRST

SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', devices.installed_on) AS DATE) AS period_start, MAX(devices.installed_on) AS m0 FROM public.devices LEFT JOIN public.sites ON devices.site_id = sites.site_id WHERE sites.site_name = %(f_0)s AND sites.site_name = %(f_1)s AND ((devices.installed_on >= %(p1_start_2)s AND devices.installed_on < %(p1_end_3)s) OR (devices.installed_on >= %(p2_start_4)s AND devices.installed_on < %(p2_end_5)s)) GROUP BY CAST(DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', devices.installed_on) AS DATE) HAVING MAX(devices.installed_on) >= %(h_6)s ORDER BY period_start NULLS FIRST
